title: Und? Bleiben Sie?
desc: The question you were once asked
setting: A Sunday in Kriens, the table laid, and a new person answering a question you got wrong six years ago.

options.feedback: Honest, short, finished. He will nod and ask nothing else, and that is the whole exam.
After four months that is a promise nobody asked for, and he will remember it.

options.es: Das kommt darauf an, wie es mit der Arbeit läuft, und dann ist da noch die Wohnung.
options.en: That depends how things go with the job, and then there is the flat as well.
options.feedback: Three sentences where he left room for four words. He asked once.

steps.speaker: Marianne
steps.es: Selina sagt, Sie spielen in einer Guggenmusik.
steps.en: Selina says you play in a Guggenmusik.

options.es: Ich spiele Trommel. Auf zwei und auf vier.
options.en: I play the drum. On two and on four.
options.feedback: The joke every single person at this table knows, told flat. Kurt will laugh into his plate.
Fine, and it answers a question that was really an invitation.

options.es: Naja, spielen ist zu viel gesagt.
options.en: Well, playing is putting it too strongly.
options.feedback: The deflection is right and this is the second one this afternoon.

steps.speaker: Marianne
steps.es: Und Ihre Familie? Kommt die auch mal?
steps.en: And your family? Do they come sometimes too?

options.en: My mother is coming in September.
options.feedback: A date. That is the answer that lets her ask about it again at Christmas.
It closes a door she opened kindly, and she will not open it again.
Honest and a bit heavy for a Sunday table. Say when, not what has not happened.
You brought it. Doing something with your hands is how you sit at this table.
Everybody says it and it gets a no. Pick a job instead of asking for one.
Right in the first year. In the sixth it puts you back outside the door.
